## Chaotic Trajectories of the Rössler System  
This document simulates and visualizes the Rössler system using the classic chaotic
parameter values:

\[
a = 0.2,\quad b = 0.2,\quad c = 5.7.
\]

The system of differential equations is:

\[
\begin{aligned}
\dot{x} &= -y - z,\\
\dot{y} &= x + a\,y,\\
\dot{z} &= b + z(x - c).
\end{aligned}
\]

We integrate the system using the **deSolve** package and visualize:

1. Time trajectories of \(x(t)\), \(y(t)\), \(z(t)\).  
2. Phase-plane plots: \(x\!-\!y\), \(x\!-\!z\), and \(y\!-\!z\).

---

```{r Retail-System, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(deSolve)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

# -----------------------------
# Define the Rossler System
# -----------------------------
rossler <- function(t, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    dx <- -y - z
    dy <- x + a * y
    dz <- b + z * (x - c)
    list(c(dx, dy, dz))
  })
}

# Parameters (chaotic regime)
parameters <- c(a = 0.2, b = 0.2, c = 5.7)

# Initial conditions
state <- c(x = 1, y = 0, z = 0)

# Time span
times <- seq(0, 500, by = 0.01)

# Solve ODE
out <- ode(y = state, times = times, func = rossler, parms = parameters)
out <- as.data.frame(out)

# -----------------------------
# Time Trajectory Plot
# -----------------------------
p_time <- ggplot(out, aes(x = time)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = x, color = "x(t)")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = y, color = "y(t)")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = z, color = "z(t)")) +
  labs(title = "Time Trajectories of the Rössler System",
       y = "Value", color = "Variable") +
  theme_minimal()

# -----------------------------
# Phase Portraits
# -----------------------------
p_xy <- ggplot(out, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_path(color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Phase Portrait: x vs y") +
  theme_minimal()

p_xz <- ggplot(out, aes(x = x, y = z)) +
  geom_path(color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Phase Portrait: x vs z") +
  theme_minimal()

p_yz <- ggplot(out, aes(x = y, y = z)) +
  geom_path(color = "darkgreen") +
  labs(title = "Phase Portrait: y vs z") +
  theme_minimal()

# Display phase portraits together
grid.arrange(p_time, p_xy, p_xz, p_yz, ncol = 2)
